'''16''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Vargus]].<ref name="The Lost Legion" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
16 is one of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] featured in the book ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion]]''. They are only directly named if [[Ace (clone trooper)|18]] becomes a [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]].<ref name="The Lost Legion" />
